stem.text: At $550\,{}^{\circ}\text{C}$ nitrogen dioxide reacts with unburnt hydrocarbon fragments, such as $\text{CH}_3$, in the catalytic converter of a motor vehicle.
Which row gives the energy change for this reaction and a possible reason for it?

A.text: endothermic; chemical energy is converted to heat energy

B.text: endothermic; the $\text{N}\equiv\text{N}$ bond energy is very high

C.text: exothermic; $\text{CO}_2$ and $\text{H}_2\text{O}$ have negative $\Delta H^{\ominus}_{\text{f}}$ values

D.text: exothermic; double bonds are broken in $\text{NO}_2$

columns: reason why the reaction is endothermic or exothermic

A: chemical energy is converted to heat energy
B: the $\text{N}\equiv\text{N}$ bond energy is very high
